paragraphs: Bunim ben Bunim. His father had a thousand ships and a thousand towns; Rabbi honored him, honoring the wealthy. Rabbi asked Rabbi Yishmael to tell the father to send his son in clothing befitting his wealth. Eruvin 85, 86; another reading in Rashi: Bunim, Rabbi’s student. See new-edition variants.
